tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: What Maps Agent has published, newest first. Without a form: how many pages each form has. With a form: its pages with title, summary, topic, date and URL, optionally narrowed by a topic word (an answer cluster such as 'reviews', a trade such as 'dentists', a guide kind such as 'template').

tools.name: define_term
tools.description: The Maps Agent glossary definition of a Google Maps, Google Business Profile or local SEO term (e.g. 'primary category', 'local citation', 'map pack', 'review gating', 'service area business'), with the URL of the full entry. Falls back to the closest answers when the glossary has no entry.
